purpose: Test whether the large batch-to-batch variation of frozen B1a can be explained or bounded by PRE-only race/meeting regime dimensions without retuning, cherry-picking or treating venue/circumference labels as deterministic rules.

confirmatory_dimensions.definition: exact active entrant count after PRE-only withdrawal handling; report 5,6,7,8,9 separately; no nearest bucket
exact day index encoded in the historical race identity; report each observed day index separately
counts of SS,S1,S2,A1,A2,A3,L1 among active entrants; report race-level class-count signature and coarse all-L1 / contains-S / A-only indicators without dropping mixed or rare signatures
counts of 逃,追,両 among active entrants; style is not line structure
population standard deviation and max-minus-min of frozen competition score within race; analyze continuously and descriptively
H(p)/log(n) from frozen B1a probabilities; fixed descriptive bins [0,0.70), [0.70,0.85), [0.85,1.0000001] plus continuous value
p(top1)-p(top2) from frozen B1a probabilities; fixed bins [0,0.05), [0.05,0.15), [0.15,1.0] plus continuous value
authoritative exact venue circumference; preserve 333.3m,335m,400m,500m and any other separately verified value without coercion
descriptive venue identity only; no venue operational rule may be promoted from this validation set

conditional_dimensions_if_parser_frozen_.definition: raw race heading label, with fixed token family 決勝/準決勝/予選/特選/一般/選抜/その他; unknown retained as OTHER/UNKNOWN
raw event grade label such as F1/F2/G3/etc; unknown retained as UNKNOWN

explicitly_excluded_dimensions.reason: not yet authoritatively bound in the current PRE parser; do not infer from style
depends on line structure; fail closed until separately verified

analysis_policy: Report overall metrics first, then every preregistered dimension including unfavorable cells.
No subgroup threshold, exclusion rule, feature weight, temperature, probability or model parameter may be changed using target outcomes.
Continuous regime dimensions are explanatory; fixed bins are reporting aids and are not purchase thresholds.
Small cells are reported with n and uncertainty warning; they are not deleted or merged after outcomes.
Any missing subgroup value is UNKNOWN and the race remains in overall scoring.
Multiple subgroup comparisons are treated as descriptive/falsification evidence. Any proposed operational subgroup rule requires a new independent preregistered confirmation.
new_universe_requirements: Must be temporally after the original frozen B1a training/freeze lineage where feasible.
Must be collision-audited against DEV2000 and every already exposed 100-race meeting/race set before result scoring.
Must exclude explicitly known smaller scored historical experiments when their race identities overlap.
Selection is frozen from PRE completeness and deterministic identity rules only; no result/payout/odds/model-performance criterion may select races.
Prediction lock is written before dedicated target result scoring.
All successfully frozen selected races are scored; no post-result deletion or replacement.
success_interpretation: Scientific progress requires demonstrating which PRE-only regime dimensions explain reproducible variation on a new collision-audited universe, or demonstrating that simple regime explanations fail. Either result is valid if preregistration and retention rules are obeyed.
